title: Company Registration & Compliance Guides | Probay
description: Plain-English guides by CA/CS professionals: choosing a structure, costs, documents, SPICe+, annual compliance, ROC due dates, demat, closing a company.
heading: Guides for founders and company owners
intro: Everything we explain to clients on calls, written down: how to choose a structure, what registration really costs, what the MCA needs, and what you must do every year afterwards. Checked against the Companies Act, the LLP Act and current MCA rules.
